description: Aggregate Aave V4 loan-swap flow over a time window: swap count, unique users, USD volume of debt rotated out, and the top from-asset → to-asset pairs. Same sources as get_v4_loan_swaps. Read-only.

chainId.description: Optional chain filter (1=Ethereum, 8453=Base, 43114=Avalanche). Omit for all three chains where Aave loan swaps are live.

windowHours.description: Lookback window in hours. Default 168 (7 days).

name: get_v4_loan_swap_stats
